whyMatters.en: St. Louis guitarist/writer whose Chess singles (1955–58) fixed duck-walk showmanship and double-stop guitar intros as rock’n’roll’s teaching dialect.
whyMatters.zh: 圣路易斯吉他手/写作者：Chess 单曲（1955–58）把鸭步表演与双音吉他前奏定为摇滚教学方言。

interviewQuotes.text: The guitar is the most important thing.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Chuck Berry

shortBio.en: Berry rock’n’roll; Johnny B. Goode is the guitar-hero syllabus.
shortBio.zh: Berry 摇滚；Johnny B. Goode 是吉他英雄教学大纲。

body.en:
Chess Records run: Maybellene, Roll Over Beethoven, Johnny B. Goode—narrative lyrics about cars, youth, and guitar ambition over Johnny Johnson piano and driving backbeats.

Johnny B. Goode (1958) is the eternal intro riff. Beatles, Stones, and garage bands learn the dialect from these 45s.
body.zh:
Chess 厂牌系列：Maybellene、Roll Over Beethoven、Johnny B. Goode——汽车、青年与吉他野心叙事歌词，叠 Johnny Johnson 钢琴与驱动性后拍。

Johnny B. Goode（1958）是永恒前奏 riff。Beatles、Stones 与车库乐队从这些 45 转学会方言。

body.en:
Berry matters as songwriter-guitarist: verse stories + signature intros. Rock bands treat his singles as homework.

Showmanship is documented; the riffs are the export.
body.zh:
Berry 作为词曲-吉他手要紧：主歌故事 + 标志前奏。摇滚乐队把他的单曲当作业。

表演术有文献；riff 才是输出。

title.zh: Johnny B. Goode：教学大纲 riff

body.en:
Double-stop intro everyone learns; lyric about a guitar kid—meta and practical.

1958 Chess clarity.
body.zh:
人人会弹的双音前奏；关于吉他少年的歌词——既元又实用。

1958 Chess 清晰度。

body.en:
Country/R&B hybrid beat, storytelling verse—1955 breakthrough side.

Template for rock lyric as short story.
body.zh:
乡村/R&B 混成节拍、叙事主歌——1955 突破面。

摇滚歌词作短篇故事的模板。

body.en:
UK beat groups cover Berry before writing originals; guitar education pipelines through his intros.

DNA is lick + lyric craft.
body.zh:
英国 beat 组合在写原创前翻唱 Berry；吉他教育管道经他的前奏。

DNA 是乐句 + 歌词工艺。

body.en:
When quotes exist, they often stress craft and audience. Prefer that over romance.

Records remain primary.
body.zh:
有引语时，常强调工艺与观众。宁取此而非浪漫。

唱片仍是第一手。

note.en: Duck-walk riffs made rock portable and teachable.
note.zh: 鸭步 riff 让摇滚变得可携带、可传授。
